Year introduced: 2024

Identify your iPhone model

Capacity1

  • 128GB

  • 256GB

  • 512GB

Display

  • Super Retina XDR display

  • 6.1‑inch (diagonal) all‑screen OLED display

  • 2556‑by‑1179-pixel resolution at 460 ppi

  • Dynamic Island

  • HDR display

  • True Tone

  • Wide color (P3)

  • Haptic Touch

  • 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio (typical)

The iPhone 16 display has rounded corners that follow a beautiful curved design, and these corners are within a standard rectangle. When measured as a standard rectangular shape, the screen is 6.12 inches diagonally (actual viewable area is less).

Chip

  • A18 chip

  • 6‑core CPU with 2 performance and 4 efficiency cores

  • 5‑core GPU

  • 16‑core Neural Engine

Power and Battery5

  • Video playback: Up to 22 hours

  • Video playback (streamed): Up to 18 hours

  • Audio playback: Up to 80 hours

  • Built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery

  • Fast-charge capable: Up to 50% charge in around 30 minutes6 with 20W adapter or higher (available separately) paired with USB‑C charging cable, or 30W adapter or higher paired with MagSafe Charger (both available separately)
